sections.en: Combustions of the five wandering planets

summary.headline: Mars Combustion in Gemini and Cancer
summary.text: Astrological predictions for the combustion of Mars in Gemini and Cancer, including effects of planetary conjunctions or aspects on weather, crops, disease, mortality, rulers, social groups, and warfare. Named outcomes include pleurisy, phrenitis, gout, fires, crop ruin, hot winds, simooms, and sinking ships.
